01

Find an existing profile, check ownership and help with the appropriate claim or access-request process. Avoid creating a duplicate when a listing already exists.

02

Help prepare the business information and evidence for the method Google offers. Coordinate with your team and visit physical locations where needed and agreed.

03

Manage approved hours, holiday changes, contact details, images and suitable posts. Agree the content, update frequency and approval process.

04

Monitor reviews within agreed service hours, prepare or publish authorised replies, and send complaints or sensitive issues to the right person.

Review recurring feedback, missed updates and unresolved issues with your team. Use what customers say to inform practical service improvements.

The profile may already be there

Customers don’t wait for you to claim it.

A business listing can already exist, with customer reviews, before you claim or verify it. Claiming your profile is about managing your business presence, not switching reviews on for the first time.

Google requires business verification before you can reply to reviews as the business. We start by checking the existing profile and access situation, then help with the next appropriate step.

Before we get started.

Can you guarantee verification, rankings or more positive reviews?

No. Google controls verification, moderation and visibility. Customers control their reviews. Our service is the practical work of keeping your presence accurate, helping with the available processes and responding responsibly.

Do all locations need an in-person visit?

No. We review each location’s situation and the verification options Google provides. Physical visits are arranged where needed and agreed, with access, staff availability and travel planned beforehand.

Will you remove negative reviews?

We can help assess and report reviews that appear to breach Google’s policies. We cannot remove legitimate criticism or promise Google will remove a reported review. We also help the business respond and address issues that need attention.

What if someone else already controls the profile?

Start with the existing profile and the appropriate Google ownership or access-request process. We help identify the next step rather than creating a second listing to work around the issue.

Service copy is a review draft. Google controls feature eligibility and policies. Guidance checked against Google’s profile editing, posts and review best practices documentation.
